description: This source file defines a PHP class `jsAlerts` that manages JavaScript alert notifications for a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It handles adding alerts, generating alert scripts, and integrating with meetings and calls to set reminders.

classes.name: jsAlerts
classes.description: A class responsible for creating JavaScript alert notifications, including handling reminders for meetings and calls, and generating scripts to display these alerts on the client side.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the jsAlerts object, sets up default alerts, and adds notifications for scheduled activities and reminders.

methods.name: addAlert
methods.description: Adds an alert with specified type, name, subtitle, description, countdown, optional redirect, and reminder ID to the script.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Returns the complete HTML script tag containing all accumulated alert scripts.

methods.name: getRelatedName
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the name of a related parent entity given its type and ID.

methods.name: addActivities
methods.description: Fetches upcoming meetings and calls within the reminder window for the current user and adds appropriate alerts for each.
